preconditions.expression: k >= 1 and n >= 2 and k * n <= 5000
preconditions.description: Input constraints: k is the number of strings (1 ≤ k ≤ 2500), n is the length of each string (2 ≤ n ≤ 5000), and total length k·n ≤ 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) == n for s_i in strings)
preconditions.description: Each of the k input strings has exactly n lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) == n and all(len(s_i) == n for s_i in strings))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no valid string exists) or a string of length n (the candidate original string).

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(any((s_i[i] == s_j[i] and s_i[j] == s_j[j]) or (s_i[i] == s_j[j] and s_i[j] == s_j[i]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n)) for s_i in strings for s_j in strings)
postconditions.description: For every pair of input strings s_i and s_j, there exists at most one pair of indices (i, j) where s_i and s_j differ by exactly a swap of characters at those indices (or are identical).

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(any((s_i == ''.join([s if idx != i and idx != j else s_j[idx] for idx, s in enumerate(stdout)]) or s_i == ''.join([s if idx != i and idx != j else s_k[idx] for idx, s in enumerate(stdout)])) for s_i in strings for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n))
postconditions.description: Every input string s_i can be obtained from the output string by swapping exactly two characters (possibly identical) at distinct indices.
